services.name: Studio Access Program
services.desc: Besides offering classes, Pratt Fine Arts Center is also a hub where independent artists, makers, hobbyists and professionals practice their craft in a community environment. Through our Studio Access Program, Pratt Members can reserve time in our professionally equipped shared studios to work independently alongside a community of fellow artists.Interested in becoming a Studio Access user? Learn more about Pratt Memberships and the benefits of joining our creative community. Ready to get into the studio? services.name: Drop-In Art Sessions
services.desc: This is a great way to build and/or brush up on your figure drawing skills with fellow creative community. Plus, you can truly make each drawing session your own as there are no designated instructions + all you'll need to bring is yourself, paper, and some drawing tools! Location:Pratt's Painting/Drawing Studio (Yellow Building)1902 S Main St.Seattle, WA
